sources: https://midnrreservations.com/ (Porcupine Mountains Wilderness State Park, map 'Union Bay': /api/maps + /api/resourcelocation/resources + /api/attribute/filterable)

values.note: DNR rate table for Union Bay: 20/30-amp $41, 50-amp $46 (the booking site's catalog lists every Union Bay site as 20/30-amp). A Recreation Passport is required for vehicle entry into all state park and forest campgrounds, on top of the camping fee.

fees.source: https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/camping-and-lodging-rates-and-operating-dates (Porcupine Mountains / Union Bay: Modern camping 50 AMP rate $46, 20/30 AMP rate $41; season May 15 - October 31) + https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/porkies ('A Recreation Passport (park pass) is required for vehicle entry into all state park and forest campgrounds'), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: https://midnrreservations.com/ per-site catalog for map 'Union Bay' (all 96 campsites: Electrical Service 20 Amps/30 Amps, 'Electric Only', Water Hookup No, Sewer Hookup No) + https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/porkies ('the park's only modern campground offering electrical service'), read 2026-10-22. The DNR rate table also prints a 50-amp rate for Union Bay, but no site in the catalog is 50-amp, so 30 is recorded.

values.note: DNR: 'Number of sites: 100'; 96 are on the booking site. 'A variety of campsite sizes; some are ideal for tents or smaller campers, while others can accommodate larger RVs': the booking site allows 25 ft or more at 89 of the 96 (35 ft or more at 62, 50 ft at 14); 7 take only 20 ft. None is a pull-through.

sites.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/porkies ('Number of sites: 100') + https://midnrreservations.com/ per-site catalog for map 'Union Bay' (allowed 'Trailer or RV up to N'' equipment per site; Pull Through=No on all 96), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Sanitation station at Union Bay with potable water and two lanes. The Simple Adventures store near the campground entrance sells supplies and firewood and rents canoes and kayaks. Boat launch and accessible fishing pier beside the campground; free Wi-Fi at the visitor center late May - mid-October.

facilities.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/porkies ('a modern toilet building, a sanitation station, boat launch, camp store'; 'The park's sanitation station is located at Union Bay Modern Campground. There is potable water and two lanes'; campground tags 'Toilet & shower building', 'Vault toilet', 'Concession or store'), read 2026-10-22

booking.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/porkies (Porcupine Mountains Union Bay Modern Campground: 'For reservations call 800-447-2757 or reserve online'), read 2026-10-22

summary: Confirmed on the DNR pages and booking site: $41 (20/30-amp) - $46 (50-amp) for 2026 with the Recreation Passport in fees.note; season May 15 - Oct 31 already manual. Added 30-amp electric only (no water/sewer at sites), 100 sites (96 online, up to 50 ft, no pull-throughs), showers/flush and vault toilets/dump/store, reservable on midnrreservations.com. --AWH note kept (DNR: 'Several of the campsites are located along the shore'). Booking window/max stay not stated for this park (left inherited).
flags: Website is only the bare reservation home page (https://midnrreservations.com/): the park's own page is https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/porkies (give it first). Phone 906-885-5275 matches the park's.
The DNR rate table prints a 50-amp rate ($46) for Union Bay while every site on midnrreservations.com is listed as 20/30-amp; electric recorded as 30, fees keep the table's $41-46.
